bio: Alessio was baptized on 19 September 1772, son of Michele Moraca and Anna Maria Putero ([R4-S1]). This makes him the brother of Agata Moraca, Fortunato Ferlaino's mother. The site shows no parents for him; they are already in the tree as I282824815622 and I282824815627. He married Saveria Sacco on 24 September 1792 ([R4-S2]).
funFacts: Alessio and his sister Agata are both John's ancestors, so Michele Moraca and Anna Maria Puteri appear twice in his pedigree.
